title: Microsoft establishes an organization with 6,000 staff specializing in engineering, corporate training, and management to support businesses with AI deployments (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: Microsoft establishes an organization with 6,000 staff specializing in engineering, corporate training, and management to support businesses with AI deployments — Microsoft is launching a new AI “company.” It won't be a separate legal entity, and most of its 6,000 people already work at Microsoft.
